tei:div.tei:p: /skra chog sogs sna tshogs bzhugs/ tshe ldan gyi skra'am tshe 'das kyi don du rus chog byed par 'dod na/ rdzas mgul 'ching dang bcas pa'i bum pa sta gon byas la/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bsal bar gyur/ bum pa amṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du/ pad zla'i gdan la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa yod na byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ chos dbyings rang bzhin in+d+ra ni la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sa gnon mnyam gzhag can/ /lha yi gos dang rin chen rgyan mang mdzes/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug nas sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur par bsams la/ kaṃ ka ni ci nus dang mthar yig brgya bzlas te/

bum lha ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsams/ de nas skra yod na skra dang rus pa yod na/ rus pa rnams kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ yig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa bum pa'i chu dang 'dres te skra'am rus pa la thim pas che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur bar bsams la/ kaṃ ka ni dang ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pra marda na ye swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla zhing bum pa'i chus khrus bya/ bar bar dang mthar che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces brjod/ rgyas par 'dod na 'di nyid sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu zhes sogs phyin drug re re'i mthar/ kaṃ ka ni zhes brjod cing*/ de bzhin du/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams zhes sogs la'ang sbyar te bkru bar bya'o/ /yang*/ rus chog bsdus pa byed na/ rang nyid mi 'khrugs pa sogs su bskyed de/ bum pa dri bzang gi chus bkang ba la dmigs nas sngar gyi gzungs rnams bzlas la/ rus pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ rus pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar pos mtshan pa/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas dmigs yul gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs shing dag par gyur par bsams la/ sngags gsum po ci nus brjod cing bum pa'i chus bkru zhing*/ spel tshig kyang brjod/ bkrus pa'i chu 'bab chur 'dor ba 'am/ yang na rus pa dang sbyar nas sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i sa la bsres kyang rung zhing*/ skra'am rus pa rnams zhib par btags te 'jim pa dang bsres la gzungs ming spel dang bcas pa nang du bcug pa'i sāts+tsha lag len ltar gdab par bya'o/ /ma nus na chu bo'am ri'i rtse nas rlung la bskur bar bshad/

de ltar rus chog tshul bzhin du byas na gang zag de ngan 'gro las grol bar 'gyur zhes mi 'khrugs pa'i rgyud las gsung ngo*/ /ces pa 'di yang gzhan gyis bskul ba'i ngor shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis dam pa'i gsung las 'byung ba'i don bsdus nas bris pa'o// //bkra shis// //༄༅/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ngur smrig gar gyis rnam rol tsong kha pa/ /sras mchog zla med mkhas grub chen po'i zhabs/ /shugs drag gus pa'i yid kyis nye bar brten/ /'dir rje bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang nye bar 'brel ba'i lta khrid mdor bsdus zhig mjug pa bde ba'i ched du tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas brjod par bya ste/ de yang skyabs 'gro sngon du btang nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng*/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun tsong kha pa/ /sku mdog dkar gsal mdzes pa'i 'dzum zhal can/ /phyag gnyis chos 'khor phyag rgyas ut+pal steng*/ /shes rab ral gri sher phyin glegs bam 'dzin/ /gser mdog pan zhwa gsol zhing ngur smrig gi /chos gos gsum gyi na bzas mngon par spras/ /mtshan dpes nyer mdzes 'od kyi gum khyim dbus/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs gnas gsum du/ /yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig 'od zer gyis/ /rang bzhin gnas nas kun mkhyen btsong kha pa/ /rgyal ba sras bcas tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba/ /spyan drangs dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du/ /thim pas mchog gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid gyur/ / skyabs gnas kun 'dus rje btsun bla ma la/ /grangs med lus sprul sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /rab 'byams zhing gi mchod rdzas ji snyed dang*/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas te 'bul/ /thog med dus nas sgo gsum gyis bsags pa'i/ /sdig sgrib nyes pa'i tshogs kun so sor 'chags/ /rang gzhan skye 'phags yongs kyis legs bskrun pa'i/ /rnam dkar dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*/

/rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /'gro ba'i don phyir chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings nyid du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par rab bzhugs gsol/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa/ /kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /de nas dmigs brtse ma ci nus bzlas nas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bdag nyid bla ma la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs nges 'byung byang sems dang*/ khyad par nyid kyi dgongs pa'i yang dag lta/ /myur du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes lan bdun sogs brjod pa'i mthar/ de ltar gsol bas bla ma'i gnas gsum las/ /bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum rim can dang*/ /cig car byung nas bdag gi gnas gsum du/ /thim pas sgrib bzhi yongs dag dbang bzhi thob/ /sku bzhi 'grub pa'i nus pa rnam par bzhag /bla ma dgyes bzhin rang gi spyi bor byon/ /'od kyi phung por gyur te spyi gtsug nas/ /snying dbus zhugs nas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /skye ba kun du yang dag bla ma dang*/ /zhes sogs kyang 'don no/ /de nas lta ba nyams su len pa la gsum/ bdag med gnyis gtan la 'bebs tshul/ rjes thob tu skyong tshul/ tha snyad 'jog tshul lo/ /dang po la gang zag dang*/ chos kyi bdag med gtan la 'bebs tshul gnyis las/ dang po/ gang zag bdag med gtan la 'bebs pa 'dir/ /rigs pa'i rnam grangs du ma yod pa las/ gcig dang du ma bral ba'i gtan tshigs kyi/ /dbang du byas te 'chad par byed pa la/ /gnad bzhi thog mar dgag bya nges tshul ni/ /rang cag gnyid log gnas skabs tshun chad dang*/ khyad par rang gis nyes pa ma byas bzhin/ /gzhan gyis byas par brjod tshe 'di ci zhig /nga nga snyam du snying dkyil dam sbreng sbring*/ /lhang lhang 'char ba yod pas de yi tshe/ /ngar 'dzin lhas skyes 'dzin tshul gsal bas brtag /ngar 'dzin des ni nga de phyi rol gyi/ /dngos po gzhan gyi steng du bzung min par/

/rang gi phung po 'di yi steng du ste/ /de yang lus sems re re kho na'am/ /gzugs dang tshor ba la sogs re re ba/ kho na'i steng du dmigs nas nga 'o snyam/ /mi 'dzin lus sems gnyis tshogs phung po lnga/ /so sor ma phye sbam me spyi tsam pa/ /'di steng 'dzin tshul blo yis btags tsam du/ /ma yin ma btags gong nas 'dogs rgyu yi/ /nga zhig tshugs thub grub grub lings po ru/ /bzung ba ngar 'dzin nyid kyis 'dzin tshul bzhed/ /gnyis pa khyab pa nges tshul ngar 'dzin des/ /bzung ba ltar gyi zhen don pa de nyid/ /phung lnga 'di steng grub na gcig tu 'am/ tha dad grub pa'i tshul gnyis gang rung las/ /mi 'da' phung sum med nges thag chod dper/ /yod na gcig dang du ma gang rung zhig /yin gyi gzhan du phung sum mi srid bzhin/ /gsum pa bden pa'i gcig bral nges tshul ni/ /de 'dra'i nga de rang gi phung po dang*/ /gcig pa nyid du 'thad min gang gi phyir/ /bdag ces khas len don med thal ba dang*/ /dus gcig bdag ni du ma yod 'gyur dang*/ /de 'dra'i nga de skye 'jig byed pa yi/ / rigs pa gsum gyis legs par gnod phyir ro/ /gnod byed dang po spyir ni nga'am bdag /phung po'i nye bar len pa po yin la/ /phung po bdag gi nye bar blang bya ste/ /ngar 'dzin des bzung nga de phung lnga dang*/ /gcig tu grub na rang gi mtshan nyid kyis/ /gcig tu song bas dbyer med gcig 'gyur zhing*/ /cha med gcig la nye bar len po dang*/ /nye bar slang bya'i rnam gzhag 'thad ma yin/ /gang phyir nga phung gcig tu sog ba der/ /ngas ni lus blang nga yi phung po zhes/ /rnam gzhag 'jig 'gyur nga ni lus yin dang*/ /phung po yin sogs tha snyad thal bar 'gyur/ /gnod byed gnyis pa ngar 'dzin lhan skyes des/ /bzung ba ltar gyi nga de phung lnga dang*/ /gcig tu grub na gang zag gcig nyid la'ang*/ / gzugs sogs phung po mi 'dra lnga yod ltar/

/bdag kyang so sor lnga yod 'gyur ba'am/ /yang na nga gcig yin pa de bzhin du/ /phung po lnga yang gcig tu thal bar 'gyur/ /gnod byed gsum pa spyir ni nga tsam zhig /skye 'jig byed pa 'gal ba ma yin kyang*/ /ngar 'dzin de yis bzung ba ltar gyi nga*/ /skye 'jig byed na rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i/ /skye 'jig byed par song bas de 'dra'i ngang*/ /skye 'jig byed pa'i skad cig snga phyi dang*/ /gcig gam tha dad gcig na mi 'thad de/ /skye ba snga phyi tshe 'di'i nga rnams kyang*/ /cha med gcig 'gyur 'gro ba rigs drug gi /gzhi mthun yod pa nyid du thal phyir ro/ /tha dad yin na spyir ni nga phung tsam/ /tha dad yin mod de 'dra'i nga de nyid/ /cha de kun dang tha dad du 'dod na/ /bltos med yan gar gnas pa'i tha dad du/ /'gyur bas de lta yin na skye ba sngon/ /dran 'gyur srid pa nyid du 'thad ma yin/ /gzhan yang ma byas las dang 'phrad pa dang*/ /byas pas chud zos 'gyur te bden grub kyis/ /nga yis las bsags de 'dra'i nga gzhan gyis/ /'bras bu myong bar 'dod pa de yis phyir/ khyab ste bden par grub pa 'jig srid na/ /phyis ni skye ba yin pa 'thad ma yin/ /de phy-ir de 'dra'i nga de phung lnga'i steng*/ /gcig tu grub pa min snyam yang yang bsam/ /bzhi pa bden pa 'du bral nges tshul ni/ /gal te phung po rnams dang gcig min kyang*/ /tha dad yin nam snyam na mi 'thad de/ /de lta na ni rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i/ /tha dad song phyir 'brel med tha dad par/ /'gyur te dper na ka ba bum pa bzhin/ /phung lnga so sor bsal ba'i logs zhig tu/ /nga de yan gar mthong du yod dgos na/ /de ni mthong ba yod pa ma yin te/ /phung po tshogs rgyun steng du nga'o snyam/ /blo skye phung po 'byung dang 'jig pa'i tshe/ /nga yang skye 'jig byed par 'jog phyir ro/ /de yang phung po mthong bas nga mthong dang*/ /phung po na bas nga yang na'o zhes/

/'jog pa'i tha snyad legs par 'thad pa nyid/ /de phyir gdags gzhi phung po las gzhan du/ /bltos med bdag ni yod pa min snyam bsam/ /gzhan yang rigs pa'i rnam grangs 'di lta ste/ /dper na thag khra'i steng du mun bab par/ /sbrul lo snyam du rtog pa de yi tshe/ /de steng sbrul de blo yis btags pa tsam/ /ma gtogs thag khra'i tshogs rgyun ya gyal sogs/ /gang yang sbrul du yod pa min de ltar/ /phung po tshogs rgyun steng du ma rig pa'i/ /mun pa bab par bdag tu 'khrul pa'i blo/ /skye la de tshe phung po'i steng du bdag /btags tsam ma gtogs phung po'i tshogs rgyun dang*/ /ya gyal gang yang bdag min de las kyang*/ /don gzhan yan gar bdag ni med pa'i phyir/ /rang dbang thub pa'i bdag med snyam du bsam/ /gzhan yang rin chen 'phreng ba las gsung ltar/ /skyes bu sa min chu min me khams min/ /rlung min nam mkha' ma yin rnam shes min/ /'dus tsam ma yin phung las don gzhan min/ /'jug par gsung bzhin phung dang gcig ma yin/ /phung dang ngo bo tha dad kyang min te/ /ri la shing ltar phung po'i rten du dang*/ /nags na stag bzhin phung por brten nas min/ /rang gi nor bzhin ngo bo tha dad dang*/ /rna ba bzhin du ngo bo gcig tu yang*/ /bden par yod min phung po'i tshogs pa dang*/ /dbyibs kyang bdag tu 'thad pa nyid min te/ /dper na shing rta rang gi yan lag steng*/ /rnam bdun rigs pas btsal na mi rnyed bzhin/ /de ltar dpyad pas ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyis/ /bzung ba ltar gyi nga med nges pa na/ /dbu ma'i lta ba rnyed pa yin zhes gsung*/ /chos kyi bdag med nyams su len pa la/ rigs pa'i rnam grangs mang yang mdor bsdu na/ /rang gi lus 'dir dmigs pa'i ngar 'dzin gyi/ /blo des lus 'di gdags gzhi yan lag gi /tshogs pa'i steng du btags pa tsam min par/ /yan lag lnga steng lus zhig tshugs se ru/ /grub par snang zhing snang ba ltar 'dzin pa/

/rang lus bden par grub pa'i 'dzin tshul te/ /de 'dra'i lus de yan lag lnga yi steng*/ /gcig gam tha dad gcig na mi 'thad de/ /gang phy-ir lus dang yan lag dbyer med du/ /gcig 'gyur snga phyi bar gyi lus rnams dang*/ /yan lag kun kyang gcig tu thal ba'i phyir/ /yan lag can dang yan lag gcig 'gyur bas/ /cha dang cha can blta bya lta byed dang*/ /gcad bya gcod byed kun kyang gcig 'gyur phyir/ /bya byed las rnams gcig tu thal 'gyur na/ /de ni nam yang 'thad pa ma yin no/ /gal te yan lag tshogs dang gcig min kyang*/ /yan lag re re ba dang gcig snyam na/ /de lta na ni yan lag lnga yod ltar/ /lus kyang tshang ba lnga ru thal ba 'am/ /yang na lus gcig yin pa de bzhin du/ /yan lag lnga yang gcig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /de ltar gcig tu grub pa min snyam bsam/ /gal te yan lag rnams dang tha dad par/ /grub snyam sems na spyir ni lus nyid dang*/ /yan lag tha snyad tsam du tha dad kyang*/ /ngar 'dzin de yis bzung ltar tha dad na/ /yan lag lnga la ma bltos logs zhig tu/ /lus zhig bzung du yod par thal 'gyur na/ /yan lag stod smad so sor phye ba'i tshe/ /lus 'di rnyed par 'gyur ba yin nam ci/ /gzhan yang ri dang ra ba khang khyim sogs/ /rang rang gdags gzhi sa rdo shing la sogs/ /ji snyed yod pa kun dang gcig pa'am/ /ngo bo tha dad nyid du rnam par brtag /gcig na ri sogs gcig 'dod de bzhin du/ /sa rdo shing sogs gcig tu 'gyur ba'am/ /yang na sa rdo shing sogs thams cad kyi/ /grangs mnyam ri la sogs par thal bar 'gyur/ /ngo bo tha dad yin na sa rdo sogs/ /re re nas bsal pha rol nyid du yang*/ /sngar gyi ri sogs de ni 'di 'o zhes/ /logs su bstan du dgos na yod ma yin/ /gzhan yang shing rta rang gi gdags gzhi yi/ /yan lag steng du rtog pas btags pa tsam/ /ma gtogs yan lag sogs dang gcig pa dang*/ /tha dad nyid du brtags nas 'gog pa'am/

/tshon gyi bkod pa las ni gzugs brnyan dang*/ /sa rdor tho yor shing 'dus nags tshal lam/ /mchu zhabs tshogs la bum par btags pa sogs/ /tha snyad tsam du ma gtogs rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa med tshul sngar bzhin shes par bya/ /gzhan yang shes bya spyi tsam de nyid kyang*/ /chos rnams kun gyi steng du btags pa dang*/ /de bzhin dngos po shes pa la sogs par/ /sbyar nas gcig gam tha dad brtags la 'gog /mdor na chos rnams rang gi cha shas dang*/ /cha shas rnams kyang rang rang cha shas la/ /brten nas bzhag pa'i rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ /rang bzhin med pa'i tshul la nges par drang*/ /dpyad pas btags don mi rnyed stong pa'i ngang*/ /nges shes rgyun ldan byas nas mnyam pa 'jog /'dzin stangs zhan du song na slar yang ni/ /snang tshul brtags nas dpyad bsgom spel mar bya// //gnyis pa rjes thob mnyam gzhag las langs tshe/ /ci snang bltas pas gang zag la sogs pa/ /ming brdas bzhag pa tsam zhig lam lam du/ /blo ngor shar la lta ba dran tsam re/ /byas te dper na sgyu ma'i rta glang ni/ /snang yang de ltar grub pa med bzhin du/ /'di kun dpyad tshe rnyed pa ma yin kyang*/ /tha snyad shes ngo tsam du sgyu ma ltar/ /snang ba'i snang stong tshogs pa'i brdzun snang du/ / bsams te kun rdzob sgyu ma ltar shes bya// //gsum pa tha snyad rnam par 'jog pa'i tshul/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig 'di ltar shes bya ste/ /chos rnams kun la don dam dpyod byed kyi/ /rigs pas dpyad cing btsal na mi rnyed kyang*/ /ma brtags ma dpyad tha snyad shes ngo ru/ /rtog pas btags pa tsam du 'jig rten gyi/ /grags pa don mthun dbang gis rnam par bzhag /dper na shing rta rang gi yan lag steng*/ /rnam bdun rigs pas btsal nas mi rnyed kyang*/ /ma dpyad 'jig rten grags pas 'jog pa bzhin/ /de skad du yang dbu ma 'jug pa las/ /de ni de nyid du'am 'jig rten du/ /rnam pa bdun gyis 'grub 'gyur min mod kyi/

/rnam dpyad med par 'jig rten nyed las 'dir/ /rang gi yan lag brten nas 'dogs ces gsung*/ /'o na thag khrar sbrul dang tho yor mir/ /'dogs pa yod phyir de dag sbrul la sogs/ /dngos gnas yin par thal bar 'gyur snyam na/ /mi mtshungs de dag la ni sbrul dang mir/ /'jig rten tha snyad don mthun mi 'jug la/ /rang gi phung po'i steng du bdag gam ngar/ /tha snyad don mthun dbang gis bzhag pa'i tshul/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du 'thad pa yin/ /de ltar chos kun don dam dpyod byed kyi/ /rigs pas dpyad pa'i ngo bor yod min kyang*/ /spyir na med pa min phyir kun rdzob tu/ /blang dor dge sdig bya byed la sogs pa/ /shin tu 'thad pa nyid du 'dod pas na/ /rang bzhin stong pa'i chos la las 'bras sogs/ /rnam par 'jog pa'i tshul la nges pa drang*/ /de ltar shes na rgyal ba'i dgongs zab don/ /rnyed par gsungs shing phan yon dpag med zhig /mdo dang bstan bcos las ni bshad pa'i tshul/ /shes par byas nas brtson pas 'jug par rigs/ /de dag rnams la rgyab rten lung gi tshogs/ /mang du yod kyang 'dir ni bsdu ba'i phyir/ /ma bkod rigs pa tsam zhig mkhas pa yi/ /rjes su 'brang nas bkod pa'i rab dkar dges/ /zab mo rten 'byung rtogs pa'i nyams len gyis/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus rab bzung nas/ /'gro ba'i don phyir bla med byang chub kyi/ /go 'phang mchog nyid myur du thob gyur cig/ //ces pa 'di ni thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa dag la mkhas pa'i mkhyen pa can gnas brtan rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub kyis sbyar ba'o// //swa sti/ rgyal ba kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang*/ /mi bskyod mgon po zhes su rab grags la/ /mngon dga'i zhing gi dpal gyur bcom ldan 'das/

/mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /mgon des zhing gi bkod pa yongs bzung ba/ /mdo sde las 'byung legs par bshad pa dang*/ /zhing der skye ba'i thabs mkhas smon lam tshul/ /'pho 'khrid skra chog lta ba mdor bsdus 'di/ /gang gi thugs bskyed smon lam dag pa'i 'bras/ /nye bar smin las phyogs 'dir sngon med la/ /rang gi bgo skal nyid du thob gyur te/ /par du bzhengs pa'i mdzad bzang mngon par bstan/ /tshul 'dir 'bad las las dkar ci mchis des/ /mtha' yas 'gro 'di 'di nas 'chi 'pho'i tshe/ /bdud bzhi las rgyal rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i/ /zhal bzang mthong zhing zhing der skye bar shog /ces pa 'di ni/ mdo sngags spyi dang khyad par theg pa rim dgu'i gnad mkhyen pa'i gnas brtan rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pas/ rang nyid dam pa'i lung bstan las mngon dga'i zhing du skye ba'i rtags babs pa ltar/ der skye ba'i thabs mchog rang gis bsgyur ba dang*/ gzhan la'ang spel ba'i ched du mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod smon lam sogs par du bsgrub tshe/ bskul ba ltar sbyar ba'o// //bkra shis// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/sna tshogs kyi skor/ -PAGE 102--PAGE 103--PAGE 91-
